verses.sloka: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयार्दितः ।भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ।। ६.६०.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa praviśya purīṁ laṅkāṁ rāmabāṇabhayārditaḥ ।bhagnadarpastadā rājā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ ।। 6.60.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.

verses.sloka: मातङ्ग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः ।अभिभूतो ऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना ।। ६.६०.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mātaṅga iva siṁhena garuḍeneva pannagaḥ ।abhibhūto 'bhavadrājā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।। 6.60.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Overcome by humiliation from the high souled Rama, Ravana remained like an elephant rejected by a lion and a serpent rejected by Garuda.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! मुके बतलाओ यह वीर्यवान ओर बड़े डील- डौल वाला कौन निशाचर है,जिसके साथ बड़ी विशाल सेना है

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मदण्डप्रकाशानां विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् ।स्मरन् राघवबाणानां विव्यथे राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.६०.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: brahmadaṇḍaprakāśānāṁ vidyutsadṛśavarcasām ।smaran rāghavabāṇānāṁ vivyathe rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 6.60.3 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas remained disquieted recalling the arrows of Rama which emitted light like lightning, resembling Brahmadanda.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ये वचन सुन उत्तर में विभीपण ने कहा-- यह रावण का सेनापति है । इस राक्षस का नाम प्रहस्त है

verses.sloka: स काञ्चनमयं दिव्यमाश्रित्य परमासनम् ।विप्रेक्षमाणो रक्षांसि रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६०.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kāñcanamayaṁ divyamāśritya paramāsanam ।viprekṣamāṇo rakṣāṁsi rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.60.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana seated on the wonderful golden magnificent throne gazing at Rakshasas spoke these words.
translations.hindi: लङ्का में रावण के अधीन जितनी सेना हे, उसमें से एक तिहाई सेना इसके अधीन हे । यह असरों का चलाना जानता है और एक प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी हे

verses.sloka: सर्वं तत् खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः ।यत् समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेणास्मि निर्जितः ।। ६.६०.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvaṁ tat khalu me moghaṁ yattaptaṁ paramaṁ tapaḥ ।yat samāno mahendreṇa mānuṣeṇāsmi nirjitaḥ ।। 6.60.5 ।।।।

translations.english: " All the penance which I have done, and the asceticism practised by me equal to Mahendra has become purposeless and defeated."
translations.hindi: भीम पराक्रमी ओर विशालकाय प्रहस्त, राक्षसी सेना के साथ गजता हुआ लङ्का के बाहिर आया

verses.sloka: इदं तद्ब्रह्मणो घोरं वाक्यं मामभ्युपस्थितम् ।मानुषेभ्यो विजानीहि भयं त्वमिति तत्तथा ।। ६.६०.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: idaṁ tadbrahmaṇo ghoraṁ vākyaṁ māmabhyupasthitam ।mānuṣebhyo vijānīhi bhayaṁ tvamiti tattathā ।। 6.60.6 ।।।।

translations.english: The dreadful words of Brahma spoken to me" know that danger from humans is coming to be true.
translations.hindi: उसने वानरों की बड़ी बलवान सेना को देखा, जो उसे ( प्रहस्त को ) देख अत्यन्त कुपित हो गजे रही थी

verses.sloka: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः ।अवध्यत्वं मया प्राप्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम् ।। ६.६०.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ ।avadhyatvaṁ mayā prāptaṁ mānuṣebhyo na yācitam ।। 6.60.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "I sought protection from Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Rakshasas and serpents but not asked for protection from humans."
translations.hindi: % एक संस्करण में इसके पूर्व यह और है--“आगच्छुति महावेगः किंरूपबलपौरुषः |? < खङ्गशकत्यृष्टिबाणाश्च शूलानि मुसलानि च । गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः

verses.sloka: विदितं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम् ।इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथेन अनरण्येन यत्पुरा ।। ६.६०.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: viditaṁ mānuṣaṁ manye rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam ।ikṣvākukulanāthena anaraṇyena yatpurā ।। 6.60.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: उत्पत्स्यते हि मद्वंशे पुरुषो राक्षसाधम ।यस्त्वां सपुत्रं सामात्यं सबलं साश्वसारथिम् ।निहनिष्यति सङ्ग्रामे त्वां कुलाधम दुर्मते ।। ६.६०.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: utpatsyate hi madvaṁśe puruṣo rākṣasādhama ।yastvāṁ saputraṁ sāmātyaṁ sabalaṁ sāśvasārathim ।nihaniṣyati saṅgrāme tvāṁ kulādhama durmate ।। 6.60.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: शप्तो ऽहं वेदवत्या च यदा सा धर्षिता पुरा ।सेयं सीता महाभागा जाता जनकनन्दिनी ।। ६.६०.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śapto 'haṁ vedavatyā ca yadā sā dharṣitā purā ।seyaṁ sītā mahābhāgā jātā janakanandinī ।। 6.60.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "In the past, I violated Vedavathi and got cursed by her. The same Woman born as Sita, the daughter of Janaka, is a highly blessed one."
translations.hindi: परस्पर दोनों सेनाएँ जब भिड़ गई; तब बड़ा विकट युद्ध हुआ । दोनों दी ओर के योद्धा, एक दूसरे के ऊपर शिलां और बार्णो की वर्षो करने लगे

verses.sloka: उमा नन्दीश्वरश्चापि रम्भा वरुणकन्यका ।यथोक्तास्तपसा प्राप्तं न मिथ्या ऋषिभाषितम् ।। ६.६०.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: umā nandīśvaraścāpi rambhā varuṇakanyakā ।yathoktāstapasā prāptaṁ na mithyā ṛṣibhāṣitam ।। 6.60.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Uma, Nandeeswara, Rambha and daughter of Varuna have cursed me like that and the prediction of those endowed with vision has been attained by me."

verses.sloka: एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ ।राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्द्धसु ।। ६.६०.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etadevābhyupāgamya yatnaṁ kartumihārhatha ।rākṣasāścāpi tiṣṭhantu caryāgopuramūrddhasu ।। 6.60.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "Knowing all this, make effort doing what ought to be done and let the Rakshasas strive to succeed positioned on top of the gates."

verses.sloka: स चाप्रतिमगाम्भीरो देवदानवदर्पहा ।ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ।। ६.६०.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa cāpratimagāmbhīro devadānavadarpahā ।brahmaśāpābhibhūtastu kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām ।। 6.60.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let Kumbhakarna of unparalleled profundity, capable of crushing Devas and Danavas, who is in slumber owing to the curse of Brahma be awakened."
translations.hindi: निरुच्छ्वासाः कृताः केचित्पतिता धरणीतले । विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदिप्‌ सन्धानसन्दिताः । ¦; १३ ॥ कोई कोई तो वेदम दो भूमि पर गिर पड़े, किसी का कलेजा बीर डाल. गया, किसी के शरीर बाणा से विध गए

verses.sloka: स पराजितमात्मानं प्रहस्तं च निषूदितम् ।ज्ञात्वा रक्षोबलं भीममादिदेश महाबलः ।। ६.६०.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa parājitamātmānaṁ prahastaṁ ca niṣūditam ।jñātvā rakṣobalaṁ bhīmamādideśa mahābalaḥ ।। 6.60.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let him be instructed that Prahastha endowed with mighty prowess has been defeated and killed."
translations.hindi: कोई कोई तलवार से दो ठुए्ड़े किए जाकर जमीन पर पढ़े छटपटा रहे थे। वीर राक्षर्तो ने बानरां की कोखें शूलां से फाड़ डाली

verses.sloka: द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियतां प्राकारश्चाधिरुह्यताम् ।निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ।। ६.६०.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dvāreṣu yatnaḥ kriyatāṁ prākāraścādhiruhyatām ।nidrāvaśasamāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām ।। 6.60.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let the Rakshasas climb up the defensive walls and attempt to guard. Also let Kumbhakarna be aroused from sleep."
translations.hindi: वानरों ने भी कुद हो चारों ओर रणभूमि में पेड़ों ओर शिलाओं के प्रहार से राक्षसा के दल चू कर, प्रथिवी पर गिरा दिए

verses.sloka: सुखं स्वपिति निश्चिन्तः कालोपहतचेतनः ।नव षट् सप्त चाष्टौ च मासान् स्वपिति राक्षसः ।। ६.६०.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sukhaṁ svapiti niścintaḥ kālopahatacetanaḥ ।nava ṣaṭ sapta cāṣṭau ca māsān svapiti rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.60.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "The Rakshasa, Kumbhakarna, lost consciousness is slumbering at ease and has been sleeping for six to nine months happily."
translations.hindi: प्रहस्त के ये सब दीवान नरान्तक, कुम्महचु, महानाद ओर समुन्नत वानरों को मार रहे थे

verses.sloka: मन्त्रयित्वा प्रसुप्तो ऽयमितस्तु नवमे ऽहनि ।तं तु बोधयत क्षिप्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६०.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mantrayitvā prasupto 'yamitastu navame 'hani ।taṁ tu bodhayata kṣipraṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.60.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "Deliberating like this with me, Kumbhakarna is sleeping for the ninth day from now. He may be quickly informed (aroused)."
translations.hindi: उस स्मय वानरों और राक्षसों की लड़ाई में घायलों के आतं- नाद का और दीटों के खिहनाद का बड़ प्या शब्द हुआ

verses.sloka: स तु सङ्ख्ये महाबाहुः ककुदः सर्वरक्षसाम् ।वानरान् राजपुत्रौ च क्षिप्रमेव वधिष्यति ।। ६.६०.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu saṅkhye mahābāhuḥ kakudaḥ sarvarakṣasām ।vānarān rājaputrau ca kṣiprameva vadhiṣyati ।। 6.60.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "Endowed with broad shoulders, he is the foremost of Rakshasas. He will crush many Vanaras immediately and the two princes (Rama and Lakshmana)."
translations.hindi: क्रोध में भर अपना युद्ध कौशल दिखलाते हुए वानर ओर राक्षस, नेत्र टेढे कर कर ओर निडर हो, बड़ी निष्ठुरता से युद्ध कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: एष केतुः परः सङ्ख्ये मुख्यो वै सर्वरक्षसाम् ।कुम्भकर्णः सदा शेते मूढो ग्राम्यसुखे रतः ।। ६.६०.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa ketuḥ paraḥ saṅkhye mukhyo vai sarvarakṣasām ।kumbhakarṇaḥ sadā śete mūḍho grāmyasukhe rataḥ ।। 6.60.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "He, (Kumbhakarna) is the foremost chief among all Rakshasas enumerated. In that way he is distinguished. But he is insensate, remains addicted always to indecent delight in the form of sleep."

verses.sloka: रामेण हि निरस्तस्य सङ्ग्रामे ऽस्मिन् सुदारुणे ।भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते ।। ६.६०.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa hi nirastasya saṅgrāme 'smin sudāruṇe ।bhaviṣyati na me śokaḥ kumbhakarṇe vibodhite ।। 6.60.20 ।।।।

translations.english: " After Kumbhakarna is fully aroused, my sorrow impelled in this terrible comb at with Rama will not be there."

verses.sloka: किं करिष्याम्यहं तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि ।ईद्दशे व्यसने प्राप्ते यो न साह्याय कल्पते ।। ६.६०.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ kariṣyāmyahaṁ tena śakratulyabalena hi ।īddaśe vyasane prāpte yo na sāhyāya kalpate ।। 6.60.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "What can I do if he does not assist me in such a dreadful comb at because of his weakness, even though he is equal to Indra in strength"
translations.hindi: वे चारों खदेड़ खदेड़ कर बानरों को मार रहे थे कि, द्विविद ने पर्वत के एक शिखर से नरान्तक को सार॑ डाला ॥ २०.॥ ` दुखः ®पुनरेस्पाव्य कपि; स विधुलडुमम । रासं चिप्रहस्तस्तु सञ्चुन्नतमपोथयत्‌

verses.sloka: ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः ।जग्मुः परमसम्भ्रान्ताः कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् ।। ६.६०.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te tu tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ ।jagmuḥ paramasambhrāntāḥ kumbhakarṇaniveśanam ।। 6.60.22 ।।।।

translations.english: On listening to the Rakshasa king's words, the Rakshasas went to the abode of Kumbhakarna highly puzzled.
translations.hindi: वह युद्धभूमिमयी नदी, कायरों के लिए दुस्तर थी। जैसे शरदऋतु में नदियाँ हंस, सारस आदि जलतटवासी पक्षियों से सेवित होती हैं

verses.sloka: ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।गन्धमाल्यांस्तथा भक्ष्यानादाय सहसा ययुः ।। ६.६०.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te rāvaṇasamādiṣṭā māṁsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ ।gandhamālyāṁstathā bhakṣyānādāya sahasā yayuḥ ।। 6.60.23 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.
translations.hindi: कपिवर वीर्यवान्‌ तार ने एक बड़े पेड़ के प्रहार से कुम्भ हनु के सिर को चकनाचूर कर दिआ। इस प्रहार से कुम्भहनु ने भी युद्ध करते हुए प्राण त्याग दिए

verses.sloka: तां प्रविश्य महाद्वारां सर्वतो योजनायताम् ।कुम्भकर्णगुहां रम्यां सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् ।। ६.६०.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ praviśya mahādvārāṁ sarvato yojanāyatām ।kumbhakarṇaguhāṁ ramyāṁ sarvagandhapravāhinīm ।। 6.60.24 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.
translations.hindi: बानरों द्वारा इस प्रकार राक्षसों का संहार प्रहस्त को असह्य हुआ। वह रथ में बैठा हुआ और धनुष बाण ले वानरों का नाश करने लगा

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्य निश्वासादवधूता महाबलाः ।प्रतिष्ठमानाः कृच्छ्रेण यत्नात् प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् ।। ६.६०.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇasya niśvāsādavadhūtā mahābalāḥ ।pratiṣṭhamānāḥ kṛcchreṇa yatnāt praviviśurguhām ।। 6.60.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The tigers among Rakshasas entered the residence paved with gold and precious stones, a delightful one and saw sleeping Kumbhakarna of great prowess.
translations.hindi: ओर पवन के वेग स आकाश में उडते हुए बड़े बड़े बादलों के समान सेनापति प्रहरत ने अपनी सेना, को युद्ध से भागते देख

verses.sloka: तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां शुभां काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् ।ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्रं शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ।। ६.६०.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ praviśya guhāṁ ramyāṁ śubhāṁ kāñcanakuṭṭimām ।dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghraṁ śayānaṁ bhīmadarśanam ।। 6.60.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas collected together started to awaken Kumbhakarna, who was like a scattered mountain in dead sleep.
translations.hindi: युद्धविशारद प्रहस्त क्रुद्ध हो, बडे बढे बार्णो को वृष्टि कर वानरों को मार रहा था

verses.sloka: ते तु तं विकृतं सुप्तं विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम् ।कुम्भकर्णं महानिद्रं सहिताः प्रत्यबोधयन् ।। ६.६०.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te tu taṁ vikṛtaṁ suptaṁ vikīrṇamiva parvatam ।kumbhakarṇaṁ mahānidraṁ sahitāḥ pratyabodhayan ।। 6.60.27 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.
translations.hindi: उस समय मरे हुए वानरो और राक्षसा की लोथों से पटी हुई रणभूमि, ऐसी जान पड़ती थी; मानों पवतों से भरी हई प्रथिबी हो

verses.sloka: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुं श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम् ।त्रासयन्तं महाश्वासैः शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ।। ६.६०.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaromāñcitatanuṁ śvasantamiva pannagam ।trāsayantaṁ mahāśvāsaiḥ śayānaṁ bhīmadarśanam ।। 6.60.28 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.
translations.hindi: युद्ध क्षेत्र की वह रक्त-रञ्जित-भूमि ऐसी शोभा दै रही थी, जैसी वसन्तऋतु में टेसुओं के फूलों से ढकी हुई भूमि शोभाय- सान हुआ करती है

verses.sloka: भीमनासापुटं तं तु पातालविपुलाननम् ।शय्यायां न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गं मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् ।। ६.६०.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhīmanāsāpuṭaṁ taṁ tu pātālavipulānanam ।śayyāyāṁ nyastasarvāṅgaṁ medorudhiragandhinam ।। 6.60.29 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.

verses.sloka: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गं किरीटिनमरिन्दमम् ।ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६०.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadanaddhāṅgaṁ kirīṭinamarindamam ।dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghraṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.60.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Rakshasas placed a heap of me at the size of Meru Mountain to please him immensely.
translations.hindi: शाद्दल- भूजन्यतृणानि यस्यांतां । ( गो० ) इस नदी में यकृत ( दहिनी कोख का माँस ) और प्लीहा ( पिलही_बाई कोख का माँच ) रूपी कीचड़ था, इधर उधर बिखरी हुई आँतें रूपी इसमें सिबार ( जल में उत्पन्न होने वाली घास विशेष) थी। कठे हुए शरीर और सिर रूपी उसमें मछलियाँ थीं । कटे हुए हाथ पैर कान नाक आदि शरीर के अवयव रूपी घास फूस, उस नदी में उतरा रडे थे

verses.sloka: ततश्चक्रुर्महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णाग्रतस्तदा ।मांसानां मेरुसङ्काशं राशिं परमतर्पणम् ।। ६.६०.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataścakrurmahātmānaḥ kumbhakarṇāgratastadā ।māṁsānāṁ merusaṅkāśaṁ rāśiṁ paramatarpaṇam ।। 6.60.31 ।।।।

translations.english: The tigers of the south west Rakshasas piled up a mass of marvellous food like the me at of buffaloes, swine, and antelopes.
translations.hindi: उस नदी के तट पर गीध, हंस, कंक, सारस बैठे हुए थे। बीरों का चर्वीरूपी फेन नदी में उतरा रहा था । घायल वीरों का आत्तैशबर मानों उस नदी के जल का कलकल शाब्द था

verses.sloka: मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च सञ्चयान् ।चकुर्नैर्ऋतशार्दूला राशिमन्नस्य चाद्भुतम् ।। ६.६०.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mṛgāṇāṁ mahiṣāṇāṁ ca varāhāṇāṁ ca sañcayān ।cakurnairṛtaśārdūlā rāśimannasya cādbhutam ।। 6.60.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas placed thirty three kinds of meat, pails of blood, and a variety of wines in front of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: ततः शोणितकुम्भांश्च मद्यानि विविधानि च ।। ६.६०.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śoṇitakumbhāṁśca madyāni vividhāni ca ।। 6.60.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Again, they daubed Kumbhakarna with highly fragrant sandal paste to take in fragrance, with wonderful garlands and perfumes.
translations.hindi: आर कमलपराग से बणान्तर को प्राप्त नदी को पार कर गजेन्द्र, जैसे लाल रंग के हो जाते हूं, वैसे ही इस दुस्तर रणरूपी नदी को पार कर, वानरश्रेष्ठो और बीर राक्षो के शरीर लाल रंग के हो गए ॥ ( गो० )

verses.sloka: पुरस्तात् कुम्भकर्णस्य चकुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः ।लिलिपुश्च परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम् ।। ६.६०.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: purastāt kumbhakarṇasya cakustridaśaśatravaḥ ।lilipuśca parārdhyena candanena parantapam ।। 6.60.34 ।।।।

translations.english: They also burnt incense, sandal to send forth fragrance to gratify Kumbhakarna and thundered like clouds here and there.
translations.hindi: प्रहस्त को रथ पर सवार हो बड़े वेग से. बाणों की वर्षो द्वारा वानरों का संहार करते हए वानरसेनापति नील ने देखा

verses.sloka: दिव्यैराच्छादयामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैः सुगन्धिभिः ।धूपं सुगन्धं ससृजुस्तुष्टुवुश्च परन्तपम् ।। ६.६०.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: divyairācchādayāmāsurmālyairgandhaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।dhūpaṁ sugandhaṁ sasṛjustuṣṭuvuśca parantapam ।। 6.60.35 ।।।।

translations.english: They blew moon size conches shining brightly. Intolerant Rakshasas raised loud noise simultaneously.

verses.sloka: जलदा इव चोन्नेदुर्यातुधानास्ततस्ततः ।शङ्खानापूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् ।तुमुलं युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः ।। ६.६०.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jaladā iva conneduryātudhānāstatastataḥ ।śaṅkhānāpūrayāmāsuḥ śaśāṅkasadṛśaprabhān ।tumulaṁ yugapaccāpi vineduścāpyamarṣitāḥ ।। 6.60.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Those night rangers drawing the limbs of Kumbhakarna pushed his arms, clapping loudly to awaken him making a sound.
translations.hindi: सूर्यं सम प्रकाशित रथ को बढ्वा, प्रहस्त, नील के सामने गया । फिर घनुर्धारियों में श्रेष्ठ सेनापति प्रहस्त ने अपने बड़े धनुष के खेच कर नील के ऊपर बाण छोड़े वे बाण नील के शरीर को वेध कर,

verses.sloka: नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः ।कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वनम् ।। ६.६०.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nedurāsphoṭayāmāsuścikṣipuste niśācarāḥ ।kumbhakarṇavibodhārthaṁ cakruste vipulaṁ svanam ।। 6.60.37 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the conchs, and of the clapping of arms, and thundering like a lion, the birds playing in the sky got scattered and fell.

verses.sloka: सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादमास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिंहनादम् ।दिशो द्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवं किरन्तः श्रुत्वा विहङ्गाः सहसा निपेतुः ।। ६.६०.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saśaṅkhabherīpaṇavapraṇādamāsphoṭitakṣvelitasiṁhanādam ।diśo dravantastridivaṁ kirantaḥ śrutvā vihaṅgāḥ sahasā nipetuḥ ।। 6.60.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna sleeping like that, could not be awakened. Angry Rakshasas roared and hit him with mallets and maces.
translations.hindi: बड़े वेग से वैसे ही जमीन में घुस गए; जैसे क्रुद्ध सर्ष बड़ी फुर्ती से अपने बिल में घुस जाता है। अभ्नि के समान चमः चमाते पैने बाणों से घायल हो कर भी बलवान. नील ने, उस परम दुर्घष प्रहस्त को अपने ऊपर आक्रमण, करते देख, एक पेड़ उखाड़ कर उसके मारा

verses.sloka: यदा भृशार्तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा न कुम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः ।ततो मुसुण्ठीर्मुसलानि सर्वे रक्षोगणास्ते जगृहुर्गदाश्च ।। ६.६०.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadā bhṛśārtairninadairmahātmā na kumbhakarṇo bubudhe prasuptaḥ ।tato musuṇṭhīrmusalāni sarve rakṣogaṇāste jagṛhurgadāśca ।। 6.60.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.

verses.sloka: तं शैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभिर्वृक्षैस्तलैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च ।सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्णं रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः ।। ६.६०.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ śailaśṛṅgairmusalairgadābhirvṛkṣaistalairmudgaramuṣṭibhiśca ।sukhaprasuptaṁ bhuvi kumbhakarṇaṁ rakṣāṁsyudagrāṇi tadā nijaghnuḥ ।। 6.60.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Unable to bear the force of the breathing out of Kumbhakarna, the Rakshasas could not stand.
translations.hindi: उस वृक्ष के लगने पर ऋ.ढू हो गर्जते हुए रात्त श्छ प्रहस्त ने वानरों के सेनापति नील के ऊपर बाणा की वर्षा की

verses.sloka: तस्य निःश्वासवातेन कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः ।राक्षसा बलवन्तो ऽपि स्थातुं नाशक्नुवन् पुरः ।। ६.६०.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya niḥśvāsavātena kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ ।rākṣasā balavanto 'pi sthātuṁ nāśaknuvan puraḥ ।। 6.60.41 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas of terrible valour resorted to abandoned drums and tom toms that way and pails of clay.
translations.hindi: उस महाबली प्रहस्त के भयङ्कर बाणो को रोकने में असमर्थ हो नील ने नेत्र बन्द कर उन्हें वैसे ही सहन किआ

verses.sloka: ततः परिहिता गाढं राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.६०.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ parihitā gāḍhaṁ rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.60.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Ten thousand Rakshasas surrounded him all at once like a mass of antimony striking him and even made a loud noise. But he never responded.
translations.hindi: जैसे शरदऋतु की शीघ्र होने वाशी वर्षो को वृषभ सहन कर लेता है । इस प्रकार प्रहस्त की दुस्सह और सुदारुण बाणः वृष्टि को नील ने नेत्र बन्द कर सहन कर किआ । फिर उस शरबृष्टि से अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो और साल का एक बडा पेड़

verses.sloka: मृदङ्गपणवान् भेरीः शङ्खकुम्भगणांस्तदा ।दशराक्षससाहस्रा युगपत् पर्यवादयन् ।। ६.६०.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mṛdaṅgapaṇavān bherīḥ śaṅkhakumbhagaṇāṁstadā ।daśarākṣasasāhasrā yugapat paryavādayan ।। 6.60.43 ।।।।

translations.english: They called him again and again, but he never got up. Then they made a difficult and dreadful effort approaching him.

verses.sloka: नीलाञ्जनचयाकारास्ते तु तं प्रत्यबोधयन् ।अभिघ्नन्तो नदन्तश्च नैव संविविदे तु सः ।। ६.६०.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nīlāñjanacayākārāste tu taṁ pratyabodhayan ।abhighnanto nadantaśca naiva saṁvivide tu saḥ ।। 6.60.44 ।।।।

translations.english: They urged horses, elephants, camels, and donkeys to pounce on him, whipping with staff, whips, and goads.

verses.sloka: यदा चैनं न शेकुस्ते प्रतिबोधयितुं तदा ।ततो गुरुतरं यत्नं दारुणं समुपाक्रमन् ।। ६.६०.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadā cainaṁ na śekuste pratibodhayituṁ tadā ।tato gurutaraṁ yatnaṁ dāruṇaṁ samupākraman ।। 6.60.45 ।।।।

translations.english: The city of Lanka including the woods was filled with that noise. They pushed him with mallets with all their strength, but he did not wake up.
translations.hindi: वे दोनों पराक्रम में सिंह ओर शावूल के समान थे च! सिंह और शार्दूल ही की तरह लड़ भी रहे थे। वे दोनों पर. - क्रमी, तथा. विजयो वीर थे और युद्ध में कभी पीठ फेरने वा. न थे

verses.sloka: अश्वानुष्ट्रान् खरान्नागान् जघ्नुर्दण्डकशाङ्कुशैः ।भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गांश्च सर्वप्राणैरवादयन् ।। ६.६०.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśvānuṣṭrān kharānnāgān jaghnurdaṇḍakaśāṅkuśaiḥ ।bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgāṁśca sarvaprāṇairavādayan ।। 6.60.46 ।।।।

translations.english: All Lanka and mountains were filled by the great noise made by the Rakshasas. Even then Kumbhakarna did not wake up.
translations.hindi: एक सूसल ले रथ के नीचे कूद पड़ा । अन्त में दोनों बलवान सेनापति एक दूसरे के महाशात्रु हो गए

verses.sloka: निजघ्नुश्चास्य गात्राणि महाकाष्ठकटङ्करैः ।मुद्गरैर्मुसलैश्चैव सर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः ।। ६.६०.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nijaghnuścāsya gātrāṇi mahākāṣṭhakaṭaṅkaraiḥ ।mudgarairmusalaiścaiva sarvaprāṇasamudyataiḥ ।। 6.60.47 ।।।।

translations.english: Then was collected a thousand drums and beaten with polished gold sticks on all sides continuously.
translations.hindi: मतवाले हाथियों के समान लड़ते लड़ते, वे दोनों लोहूलुहान हो गए। दोनों ही एक दूसरे को अपने पैने पैने दांतों से चोंथ रहे थे

verses.sloka: तेन शब्देन महता लङ्का समभिपूरिता ।सपर्वतवना सर्वा सो ऽपि नैव प्रबुध्यते ।। ६.६०.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā laṅkā samabhipūritā ।saparvatavanā sarvā so 'pi naiva prabudhyate ।। 6.60.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Wrapped in sleep like that because of the spell of the curse, he had not wakened. The Rakshasas got enraged.

verses.sloka: ततः सहस्रं भेरीणां युगपत् समहन्यत ।मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामासक्तानां समन्ततः ।। ६.६०.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sahasraṁ bherīṇāṁ yugapat samahanyata ।mṛṣṭakāñcanakoṇānāmāsaktānāṁ samantataḥ ।। 6.60.49 ।।।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas endowed with mighty prowess became enraged and others started to arouse with all their strength.

verses.sloka: एवमप्यतिनिद्रस्तु यदा नैव प्रबुध्यते ।शापस्य वशमापन्नस्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः ।महाक्रोधसमाविष्टाः सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः ।। ६.६०.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamapyatinidrastu yadā naiva prabudhyate ।śāpasya vaśamāpannastataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ ।mahākrodhasamāviṣṭāḥ sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ ।। 6.60.50 ।।।।

translations.english: While some were beating the drums, some shouted at the pitch of their voice, some started pulling his hair and some bit his ears.

verses.sloka: तद्रक्षो बोधयिष्यन्तश्चक्रुरन्ये पराक्रमम् ।। ६.६०.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadrakṣo bodhayiṣyantaścakruranye parākramam ।। 6.60.51 ।।।।

translations.english: Some poured hundreds of pails of water into ears, distressed that he did not wake up under the spell of deep sleep.

verses.sloka: स्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः ।अन्ये भेरीः समाजघ्नुरन्ये चक्रुर्महास्वनम् ।केशानन्ये प्रलुलुपुः कर्णावन्ये दशन्ति च ।। ६.६०.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: stataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ ।anye bherīḥ samājaghnuranye cakrurmahāsvanam ।keśānanye pralulupuḥ karṇāvanye daśanti ca ।। 6.60.52 ।।।।

translations.english: Some had their nails fixed with mallets, letting their mallets fall on the forehead, on the chest and throw at of Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: उदकुम्भशतान्यन्ये समसिञ्चन्त कर्णयोः ।न कुम्भकर्णः पस्पन्दे महानिद्रावशं गतः ।। ६.६०.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: udakumbhaśatānyanye samasiñcanta karṇayoḥ ।na kumbhakarṇaḥ paspande mahānidrāvaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.60.53 ।।।।

translations.english: Some struck with sataghni (mace) all over his huge body fastened with cords.
translations.hindi: एक बड़ी शिला उठा ली और उस युद्धाभिलाषी और मूसल से लड़ने वाले प्रहस्त के सिर पर तुरन्त पटक दी

verses.sloka: अन्ये च बलिनस्तस्य कूटमुद्गरपाणयः ।मूर्ध्नि वक्षसि गात्रेषु पातयन् कूटमुद्गरान् ।। ६.६०.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anye ca balinastasya kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ ।mūrdhni vakṣasi gātreṣu pātayan kūṭamudgarān ।। 6.60.54 ।।।।

translations.english: A thousand elephants were made to walk over his body. Then Kumbhakarna felt the touch but did not understand.
translations.hindi: कपिश्रेष्ठ नील की फेकी हुई उत्त शिला के प्रहार से प्रहस्त ` का सिर चक्रनाचूर हो गया अथवा शिला लगने से प्रहस्त के सिर के बहुत से डुकड़े हो गए । नील की . फी हुई उस शिला के प्रहार से प्रहस्त!निर्जीब, कान्तिहीन, |बलद्दीन ओर निश्चेष्ट हो कर

verses.sloka: रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिः शतघ्नीभिश्च सर्वतः ।वध्यमानो महाकायो न प्राबुध्यत राक्षसः ।। ६.६०.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rajjubandhanabaddhābhiḥ śataghnībhiśca sarvataḥ ।vadhyamāno mahākāyo na prābudhyata rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.60.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Tormented by hunger and hit by mountain peaks and huge trees he sprang up suddenly descended and awakened.

verses.sloka: वारणानां सहस्रं तु शरीरे ऽस्य प्रधावितम् ।कुम्भकर्णस्ततो बुद्धः स्पर्शं परमबुध्यत ।। ६.६०.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vāraṇānāṁ sahasraṁ tu śarīre 'sya pradhāvitam ।kumbhakarṇastato buddhaḥ sparśaṁ paramabudhyata ।। 6.60.56 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, devoid of any beauty threw out his limbs which were like the coils of cobra and as hard as mountain tops, his mouth was unnatural like a submarine fire as he yawned.

verses.sloka: स पात्यमानैर्गिरिशृङ्गवृक्षैरचिन्तयंस्तान् विपुलान् प्रहारान् ।निद्राक्षयात् क्षुद्भयपीडितश्च विजृम्भमाणः सहसोत्पपात ।। ६.६०.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa pātyamānairgiriśṛṅgavṛkṣairacintayaṁstān vipulān prahārān ।nidrākṣayāt kṣudbhayapīḍitaśca vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ sahasotpapāta ।। 6.60.57 ।।।।

translations.english: As he yawned his mouth resembling the underworld, it was like the Sun rose over the top of Mount Meru.
translations.hindi: सिर हो से नहीं बल्कि उसके सारे शरीर से वैसे ही रक्त मरा जैसे पहाड़ से जल मारता है. । नील द्वारा प्रहरत के मारे जाने पर प्रहस्त की (कभी बिचलित न होने वाली महती सेना के

verses.sloka: स नागभोगाचलशृङ्गकल्पौ विक्षिप्य बाहू गिरिशृङ्गसारौ ।विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभं निशाचरो ऽसौ विकृतं जजृम्भे ।। ६.६०.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa nāgabhogācalaśṛṅgakalpau vikṣipya bāhū giriśṛṅgasārau ।vivṛtya vaktraṁ vaḍavāmukhābhaṁ niśācaro 'sau vikṛtaṁ jajṛmbhe ।। 6.60.58 ।।।।

translations.english: As the mighty night ranger awakened and yawned continuously his breath was like wind blowing from the mountain.
translations.hindi: राक्षस लोग उदाध हो लङ्कापुरी में चले गए । क्योंकि अप ने सेनापति के मारे जाने पर वे युद्ध में वैसे दी न टिक सके

verses.sloka: तस्य जाजृम्भमाणस्य वक्त्रं पातालसन्निभम् ।ददृशे मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे दिवाकर इवोदितः ।। ६.६०.५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya jājṛmbhamāṇasya vaktraṁ pātālasannibham ।dadṛśe meruśṛṅgāgre divākara ivoditaḥ ।। 6.60.59 ।।।।

translations.english: As Kumbhakarna woke up he appeared like the time spirit at the time of dissolution of the universe like a rainy cloud at twilight as if seeking to consume all beings.

verses.sloka: स जृम्भमाणो ऽतिबलः प्रतिबुद्धो निशाचरः ।निःश्वासश्चास्य सञ्जज्ञे पर्वतादिव मारुतः ।। ६.६०.६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa jṛmbhamāṇo 'tibalaḥ pratibuddho niśācaraḥ ।niḥśvāsaścāsya sañjajñe parvatādiva mārutaḥ ।। 6.60.60 ।।।।

translations.english: His huge eyes were like blazing fire dazzling like lightning glowing like two huge planets.
translations.hindi: राचसराज रावण के भवन में गए और चुपचाप ध्यान लगाये हुए खड़े हो गए । वे राक्षस तीत्रशोकरूपी समुद्र में निमग्न हो, अचेत से हो रहे थे

verses.sloka: रूपमुत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य तद्बभौ ।तपान्ते सबलाकस्य मेघस्येव विवर्षतः ।। ६.६०.६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rūpamuttiṣṭhatastasya kumbhakarṇasya tadbabhau ।tapānte sabalākasya meghasyeva vivarṣataḥ ।। 6.60.61 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter having seen several kinds of food items of hogs, buffaloes he ate them.
translations.hindi: इति अष्टपञ्चाशः सगे: ॥ मद्वाबली बानरयूथपति नील विजयी हो, श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण के पास गए और अपनी बहादुरी के लिए उनसे अपनी प्रशंसा सुन, वे अत्यन्त हषित हुए

verses.sloka: तस्य दीप्ताग्निसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी ।ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ ।। ६.६०.६२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya dīptāgnisadṛśe vidyutsadṛśavarcasī ।dadṛśāte mahānetre dīptāviva mahāgrahau ।। 6.60.62 ।।।।

translations.english: After eating the meat and feeling thirsty, the enemy of Indra drank blood, pails of fat and wine.

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वदर्शयन् सर्वान् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून् ।वराहान् महिषांश्चैव स बभक्ष महाबलः ।। ६.६०.६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastvadarśayan sarvān bhakṣyāṁśca vividhān bahūn ।varāhān mahiṣāṁścaiva sa babhakṣa mahābalaḥ ।। 6.60.63 ।।।।

translations.english: There upon the night rangers realizing that he got up, came before him, and greeted him with heads bent down.

verses.sloka: अदन् बुभुक्षितो मांसं शोणितं तृषितः पिबन् ।मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यं च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा ।। ६.६०.६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adan bubhukṣito māṁsaṁ śoṇitaṁ tṛṣitaḥ piban ।medaḥkumbhāṁśca madyaṁ ca papau śakraripustadā ।। 6.60.64 ।।।।

translations.english: With sleepy eyes casting his glance at the night rangers looked at all of them.

verses.sloka: ततस्तृप्त इति ज्ञात्वा समुत्पेतुर्निशाचराः ।शिरोभिश्च प्रणम्यैनं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.६०.६५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastṛpta iti jñātvā samutpeturniśācarāḥ ।śirobhiśca praṇamyainaṁ sarvataḥ paryavārayan ।। 6.60.65 ।।।।

translations.english: He, the bull among the south west region, astonished at his awakening, soothed, and spoke to all the Rakshasas in this way.

verses.sloka: निद्राविश ऽदनेत्रस्तु कलुषीकृतलोचनः ।चारयन् सर्वतो दृष्टिं तान् ददर्श निशाचरान् ।। ६.६०.६६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nidrāviśa 'danetrastu kaluṣīkṛtalocanaḥ ।cārayan sarvato dṛṣṭiṁ tān dadarśa niśācarān ।। 6.60.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "What have you done to wake me Hope King is fine and has no fear of danger"

verses.sloka: स सर्वान् सान्त्वयामास नैर्ऋतान्नैर्ऋतर्षभः ।बोधनाद् विस्मितश्चापि राक्षसानिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६०.६७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa sarvān sāntvayāmāsa nairṛtānnairṛtarṣabhaḥ ।bodhanād vismitaścāpi rākṣasānidamabravīt ।। 6.60.67 ।।।।

translations.english: "Is there any fear of some enemies Is it because of that you have woken me up Let me know."

verses.sloka: किमर्थमहमादृत्य भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः ।कच्चित् सुकुशलं राज्ञो भयवानेष वा न किम् ।। ६.६०.६८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kimarthamahamādṛtya bhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ ।kaccit sukuśalaṁ rājño bhayavāneṣa vā na kim ।। 6.60.68 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will devour Rakshasa king's fear. I will eradicate even Mahendra (mountain) or alleviate fire."

verses.sloka: अथवा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयं परमुपस्थितम् ।यदर्थमेवं त्वरितैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः ।। ६.६०.६९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athavā dhruvamanyebhyo bhayaṁ paramupasthitam ।yadarthamevaṁ tvaritairbhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ ।। 6.60.69 ।।।।

translations.english: "For a small reason he will not awaken me. Tell me the reason truly for waking me."

verses.sloka: अद्य राक्षसराजस्य भयमुत्पाटयाम्यहम् ।पातयिष्ये महेन्द्रं वा शातयिष्ये तथा ऽनलम् ।। ६.६०.७० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adya rākṣasarājasya bhayamutpāṭayāmyaham ।pātayiṣye mahendraṁ vā śātayiṣye tathā 'nalam ।। 6.60.70 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, tamer of enemies having spoken in that way in anger, Yupaksha, a minister joined palms and replied to him.

verses.sloka: न ह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तं बोधयिष्यति मां गुरुः ।तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम् ।। ६.६०.७१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hyalpakāraṇe suptaṁ bodhayiṣyati māṁ guruḥ ।tadākhyātārthatattvena matprabodhanakāraṇam ।। 6.60.71 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! there is no danger from Devas. Only a small destruction done by a human is pressing and causing pain."

verses.sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।यूपाक्षः सचिवो राज्ञः कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह ।। ६.६०.७२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ saṁrabdhaṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।yūpākṣaḥ sacivo rājñaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha ।। 6.60.72 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! This kind of fear from humans has not arisen for us either from Daityas or Danavas."

verses.sloka: न नो दैवकृतं किञ्चिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन ।मानुषान्नो भयं राजंस्तुमुलं सम्प्रबाधते ।। ६.६०.७३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na no daivakṛtaṁ kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana ।mānuṣānno bhayaṁ rājaṁstumulaṁ samprabādhate ।। 6.60.73 ।।।।

translations.english: This Lanka is seized by a mountain like army of Vanaras. By the abduction of Sita, there is little fear from Rama.

verses.sloka: न दैत्यदानवेभ्यो वा भयमस्ति हि तादृशम् ।यादृशं मानुषं राजन् भयमस्मानुपस्थितम् ।। ६.६०.७४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na daityadānavebhyo vā bhayamasti hi tādṛśam ।yādṛśaṁ mānuṣaṁ rājan bhayamasmānupasthitam ।। 6.60.74 ।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier this great city was burnt by a single Vanara who killed Prince Aksha, and his elephants and followers."

verses.sloka: वानरैः पर्वताकारैर्लङ्केयं परिवारिता ।सीताहरणसन्तप्ताद्रामान्नस्तुमुलं भयम् ।। ६.६०.७५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānaraiḥ parvatākārairlaṅkeyaṁ parivāritā ।sītāharaṇasantaptādrāmānnastumulaṁ bhayam ।। 6.60.75 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rakshasa king, scion of sage Paulastya, an enemy of Devatas, was let off from death by Rama who has the splendour of Sun."

verses.sloka: एकेन वानरेणेयं पूर्वं दग्धा महापुरी ।कुमारो निहतश्चाक्षः सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ।। ६.६०.७६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ekena vānareṇeyaṁ pūrvaṁ dagdhā mahāpurī ।kumāro nihataścākṣaḥ sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ ।। 6.60.76 ।।।।

translations.english: "The king could escape from the verge of death and such an act was never done by Daityas or Danavas earlier in the encounter."

verses.sloka: स्वयं रक्षोधिपश्चापि पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः ।मृतेति संयुगे मुक्तो रामेणादित्यतेजसा ।। ६.६०.७७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: svayaṁ rakṣodhipaścāpi paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ ।mṛteti saṁyuge mukto rāmeṇādityatejasā ।। 6.60.77 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the words of Yupaksha, regarding the insult of his brother Kumbhakarna said this rolling his eyes.

verses.sloka: यन्न दैवैः कृतो राजा नापि दैत्यैर्न दानवैः ।कृतः स इह रामेण विमुक्तः प्राणसंशयात् ।। ६.६०.७८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yanna daivaiḥ kṛto rājā nāpi daityairna dānavaiḥ ।kṛtaḥ sa iha rāmeṇa vimuktaḥ prāṇasaṁśayāt ।। 6.60.78 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will conquer now the Vanara army along with Lakshmana and Raghava in war and see Ravana."

verses.sloka: स यूपाक्षवचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्युधि पराजयम् ।कुम्भकर्णो विवृत्ताक्षो यूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६०.७९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa yūpākṣavacaḥ śrutvā bhrāturyudhi parājayam ।kumbhakarṇo vivṛttākṣo yūpākṣamidamabravīt ।। 6.60.79 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will satisfy the Rakshasas with the flesh and blood of Rama and Lakshmana. You will see."

verses.sloka: सर्वमद्यैव यूपाक्ष हरिसैन्यं सलक्ष्मणम् ।राघवं च रणे हत्वा पश्चाद्द्रक्ष्यामि रावणम् ।। ६.६०.८० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvamadyaiva yūpākṣa harisainyaṁ salakṣmaṇam ।rāghavaṁ ca raṇe hatvā paścāddrakṣyāmi rāvaṇam ।। 6.60.80 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of the reply of Kumbhakarna, filled with arrogance and pride, Mahodara, chief of the army, submitted with folded hands and said.

verses.sloka: राक्षसांस्तर्पयिष्यामि हरीणां मांसशोणितैः ।रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि स्वयं पास्यामि शोणितम् ।। ६.६०.८१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāṁstarpayiṣyāmi harīṇāṁ māṁsaśoṇitaiḥ ।rāmalakṣmaṇayoścāpi svayaṁ pāsyāmi śoṇitam ।। 6.60.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Mighty Armed One! You hear from Ravana the advantages and disadvantages and thereafter assess the enemy to conquer."

verses.sloka: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य सगर्वितं रोषविवृद्धदोषम् ।महोदरो नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यः कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ।। ६.६०.८२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tattasya vākyaṁ bruvato niśamya sagarvitaṁ roṣavivṛddhadoṣam ।mahodaro nairṛtayodhamukhyaḥ kṛtāñjalirvākyamidaṁ babhāṣe ।। 6.60.82 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, mighty strong, on hearing Mahodara went in surrounded by Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गुणदोषौ विमृश्य च ।पश्चादपि महाबाहो शत्रून् युधि विजेष्यसि ।। ६.६०.८३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā guṇadoṣau vimṛśya ca ।paścādapi mahābāho śatrūn yudhi vijeṣyasi ।। 6.60.83 ।।।।

translations.english: After rousing up Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes and fierce strength from sleep the Rakshasas quickly went to the abode of the ten headed king.

verses.sloka: महोदरवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसैः परिवारितः ।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः सम्प्रतस्थे महाबलः ।। ६.६०.८४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahodaravacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ sampratasthe mahābalaḥ ।। 6.60.84 ।।।।

translations.english: All those night rangers, approaching the tenheaded king seated on an excellent se at greeted with folded hands and said.

verses.sloka: तं समुत्थाप्य भीमाक्षं भीमरूपपराक्रमम् ।राक्षसास्त्वरिता जग्मुर्दशग्रीवनिवेशनम् ।। ६.६०.८५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samutthāpya bhīmākṣaṁ bhīmarūpaparākramam ।rākṣasāstvaritā jagmurdaśagrīvaniveśanam ।। 6.60.85 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa Lord! Your brother Kumbhakarna has come here. Greetings to you. Tell us what to do."

verses.sloka: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवमासीनं परमासने ।ऊचुर्बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे एव निशाचराः ।। ६.६०.८६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato gatvā daśagrīvamāsīnaṁ paramāsane ।ūcurbaddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve eva niśācarāḥ ।। 6.60.86 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana on his part said this to the Rakshasas feeling cheerful. "Honour him as propriety demands. I wish to see him."

verses.sloka: प्रबुद्धः कुम्भकर्णो ऽयं भ्राता ते राक्षसर्षभ ।कथं तत्रैव निर्यातु द्रक्ष्यस्येनमिहागतम् ।। ६.६०.८७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prabuddhaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'yaṁ bhrātā te rākṣasarṣabha ।kathaṁ tatraiva niryātu drakṣyasyenamihāgatam ।। 6.60.87 ।।।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas taking leave from Ravana said this again approaching Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टो राक्षसांस्तानुपस्थितान् ।द्रष्टुमेनमिहेच्छामि यथान्यायं च पूज्यताम् ।। ६.६०.८८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭo rākṣasāṁstānupasthitān ।draṣṭumenamihecchāmi yathānyāyaṁ ca pūjyatām ।। 6.60.88 ।।।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasa leaders said to Kumbhakarna," the king desires to see you. Start. Make up your mind. Be pleased to depart to your brother."

verses.sloka: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे पुनरागम्य राक्षसाः ।कुम्भकर्णमिदं वाक्यमूचू रावणचोदिताः ।। ६.६०.८९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tathetyuktvā tu te sarve punarāgamya rākṣasāḥ ।kumbhakarṇamidaṁ vākyamūcū rāvaṇacoditāḥ ।। 6.60.89 ।।।।

translations.english: Formidable and courageous Kumbhakarna also got up from sleep saying 'yes' and rose up.

verses.sloka: द्रष्टुं त्वां काङ्क्षते राजा सर्वराक्षसपुङ्गवः ।गमने क्रियतां बुद्धिर्भ्रातरं सम्प्रहर्षय ।। ६.६०.९० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: draṣṭuṁ tvāṁ kāṅkṣate rājā sarvarākṣasapuṅgavaḥ ।gamane kriyatāṁ buddhirbhrātaraṁ sampraharṣaya ।। 6.60.90 ।।।।

translations.english: Joyful Kumbhakarna, washed his face, had a bath and being thirsty ordered a drink that can increase his strength.

verses.sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुर्धर्षो भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम् ।तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबाहुः शयनादुत्पपात ह ।। ६.६०.९१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu durdharṣo bhrāturājñāya śāsanam ।tathetyuktvā mahābāhuḥ śayanādutpapāta ha ।। 6.60.91 ।।।।

translations.english: By the order of Ravana hurriedly they got several kinds of wine in pots.

verses.sloka: प्रक्षाल्य वदनं हृष्टः स्नातः परमभूषितः ।पिपासुस्त्वरयामास पानं बलसमीरणम् ।। ६.६०.९२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya vadanaṁ hṛṣṭaḥ snātaḥ paramabhūṣitaḥ ।pipāsustvarayāmāsa pānaṁ balasamīraṇam ।। 6.60.92 ।।।।

translations.english: (Kumbhakarna) Having drunk two thousand pots of wine, slightly excited and inebriated and replenished with strength and energy was ready to depart.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते त्वरितास्तस्य राक्षसा रावणाज्ञया ।मद्यकुम्भांश्च विविधान् क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन् ।। ६.६०.९३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste tvaritāstasya rākṣasā rāvaṇājñayā ।madyakumbhāṁśca vividhān kṣipramevopahārayan ।। 6.60.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna surrounded by Rakshasas going to his brother's abode happily looked like the Lord of death bent on destroying the creation. He took strides which shook the earth.

verses.sloka: पीत्वा घटसहस्रे द्वे गमनायोपचक्रमे ।ईषत्समुत्कटो मत्तस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः ।कुम्भकर्णो बभौ हृष्टः कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.६०.९४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pītvā ghaṭasahasre dve gamanāyopacakrame ।īṣatsamutkaṭo mattastejobalasamanvitaḥ ।kumbhakarṇo babhau hṛṣṭaḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।। 6.60.94 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna went like the thousand rayed Sun illuminating the earth by his splendour brightening the royal path, greeted by a circle of Rakshasas joining palms like Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices went to the abode of selfborn Brahma.

verses.sloka: भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितः ।कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ।। ६.६०.९५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātuḥ sa bhavanaṁ gacchan rakṣogaṇasamanvitaḥ ।kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayata medinīm ।। 6.60.95 ।।।।

translations.english: And then the Vanaras and the leaders of the Vanara army who were present looked at the immeasurably tall form of Kumbhakarna walking through the royal path and got alarmed.

verses.sloka: स राजमार्गं वपुषा प्रकाशयन् सहस्ररश्मिर्धरणीमिवांशुभिः ।जगाम तत्राञ्जलिमालया वृतः शतक्रतुर्गेहमिव स्वयम्भुवः ।। ६.६०.९६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa rājamārgaṁ vapuṣā prakāśayan sahasraraśmirdharaṇīmivāṁśubhiḥ ।jagāma tatrāñjalimālayā vṛtaḥ śatakraturgehamiva svayambhuvaḥ ।। 6.60.96 ।।।।

translations.english: Indeed, some took refuge from Rama who could give shelter, some fell down in panic, some went in all directions in panic, and some out of fear lay down on the ground.

verses.sloka: तं राजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनं वनौकसस्ते सहसा बहिः स्थिताः ।दृष्ट्वा ऽप्रमेयं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पं वितत्रसुस्ते हरियूथपालाः ।। ६.६०.९७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ rājamārgasthamamitraghātinaṁ vanaukasaste sahasā bahiḥ sthitāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā 'prameyaṁ giriśṛṅgakalpaṁ vitatrasuste hariyūthapālāḥ ।। 6.60.97 ।।।।

translations.english: Oppressed with fear the Vanaras ran here and there seeing the form of Kumbhakarna that was like the peak of a mountain as if touching the selfluminous Sun, crowned and wonderful, grown in size. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: केचिच्छरण्यं शरणं स्म रामं व्रजन्ति केचिद्व्यथिताः पतन्ति ।केचिद्दिशः स्म व्यथिताः प्रयान्ति केचिद्भयार्ता भुवि शेरते स्म ।। ६.६०.९८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: keciccharaṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ sma rāmaṁ vrajanti kecidvyathitāḥ patanti ।keciddiśaḥ sma vyathitāḥ prayānti kecidbhayārtā bhuvi śerate sma ।। 6.60.98 ।।।।

verses.sloka: तमद्रिशृङ्गप्रतिमं किरीटिनं स्पृशन्तमादित्यमिवात्मतेजसा ।वनौकसः प्रेक्ष्य विवृद्धमद्भुतं भयार्दिता दुद्रुविरे ततस्ततः ।। ६.६०.९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamadriśṛṅgapratimaṁ kirīṭinaṁ spṛśantamādityamivātmatejasā ।vanaukasaḥ prekṣya vivṛddhamadbhutaṁ bhayārditā dudruvire tatastataḥ ।। 6.60.99 ।।
